name: How long does a shower leak repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a shower leak repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shower leak repair depends entirely on the cause and complexity of the leak. Minor repairs, such as resealing grout or caulk, might take a few hours. More complex issues, like repairing a leaking pipe behind a wall or replacing a shower pan, could take a full day or even multiple days, especially if drying time for materials like grout or cement is required. A professional plumber can provide a more accurate time estimate after assessing the specific leak in your shower.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; minor fixes take hours, while complex issues like pipe replacement or shower pan repairs can take days. A plumber can provide an estimate after assessment.
